existing_code_facts.candidate_stream: thinking/math_data_candidate_stream.py::CandidateStream(recipe, paths, 'train') checks explicit split and exact member row counts; recipe roles are candidate_chat/candidate_source and require no pending discovery.
existing_code_facts.accepted_text_recipe: Pinned recipe has 32 candidate_chat members, 219 candidate_source members, declared 6502344 current train rows and 48 evaluation rows kept separate.
existing_code_facts.archive_audit_samples_table: id, member, line, hash, case_id, mode, split, sequence_tokens, completion_tokens, canonical_known, linkage_verified, source_hash_verified; it does not store grade, skills, method or difficulty.
existing_code_facts.archive_audit_sources_table: id, hash, raw_hash, signatures, projection; projection stores digests of source attributes, not the grade/topic values needed for stratification.
existing_code_facts.source_metadata_loader: exhaustive_colab_loader.load_source_index extracts case_kind, topic, grade and split from source records, but does not emit a persisted full per-case training feature index or calibrated method/difficulty labels.
existing_code_facts.tokenization: Not required for sampling; max sequence audited 1481, training contract limit 2048, and assistant-only tokenizer checks preserve the single EOT target.

labeling_policy.heuristic_features: Skill, method, and difficulty fallback values are explicitly tagged proxy labels. Every selected chat row is identified and SHA256-bound; this is a sampling aid, not semantic QA.

sampling.algorithm: Seeded SHA256 rank within multi-label grade/grade-skill/skill/method/difficulty buckets, deterministic round-robin over buckets, case selected at most once.
sampling.mode_policy: Include exactly the four accepted training chat modes for every selected case.
sampling.split_policy: Fail closed unless each supplied row is split=train; do not read validation or test to construct the view.
sampling.target_cases: 4000 selected whole cases by default (up to 16000 chat rows); all SGK-family cases are mandatory and must fit within target; only parent may raise target after measured time/throughput budget.
sampling.manifest_records: Selected case IDs, all four sample IDs and row SHA256 hashes, feature-index SHA256, recipe SHA256, seed, selection algorithm, and selected counts by grade/skill/method/difficulty.

runtime_locator.runtime_access: Use existing pinned training runner's GoogleDriveReader/LazyDriveCache and CandidateStream over train only; do not invoke all-split stream or load eval payloads.
runtime_locator.feature_index_output: Colab ephemeral run directory, then attach by content SHA to the new sampling manifest; no source payload rewrite.

blockers: No persisted complete per-row skill/method/difficulty index exists. The CPU worker now builds a metadata SQLite index directly from the 32 accepted candidate_chat members without tokenization or model loading.
Worker must receive the parent-provided protected evaluation-question SHA256 JSONL; it only reads the hash field and excludes any colliding training case.
The 1200-second CPU scan is bounded and not yet run; a timeout or row/hash/mode mismatch yields no sampling manifest. Include measured worker time in the 3-hour wall-clock budget.
runtime_worker: colab_train_view_worker.py::scan_and_sample(api, receipt, protected_eval_hashes_path, work_dir, target_cases=4000, seed=20261023, time_limit_s=1200)
runtime_access: Caller supplies read-only Drive v3 API; worker downloads only the 32 hash-pinned candidate_chat artifacts, verifies archive/member hashes, streams chat rows on CPU, and never opens candidate_source, validation, or test payload contents.
